subject: general
question: In a code language, 'HURDLE' is written as ‘REHVNU’ and ‘TARGET’ is written as ‘FYHSUF’.How will 'FLANKER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is: HURDLE is coded as REHVNU

TARGET is coded as FYHSUF

Similarly, FLANKER is coded as TNYLOUH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc434115dbfb07019ba6777f8dd13b0d9daf1e0a9ea84ad72f016015d3fe4dab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fad4ee31144b17da605326bc844f2d3d2db2ed5dd8357fce1e1459f84b01ddb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d667ef920e0b1d4f27891202c01c7078213431eff728171d380d5fb0aa5bfdd.png] 

Hence, **TNYLOUH **is the** correct answer**.
